value.rationale: The 2015 literature identifies the exact (6,4) maximum by computer search but leaves the equality cases structurally opaque. A complete extremizer census at this canonical small Ulam-code parameter, together with universal equidistance, 57 natural symmetry classes, and exclusion of subgroup-coset constructions, gives a reusable benchmark for constructions and symmetry-aware searches rather than a routine recomputation of the known optimum.
